qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate / Graduate Degree in Economics / MBA
qualification.details: Executive Director (Tariff): Post Graduate Degree in Economics / MBA (Finance) from a recognized University OR Graduate Degree in Electrical / Power Engineering. Experience: Experience as a professional economist / power engineer, development of tariff in power sector utilities, commercial enterprises. Executive Director (Engineering): Graduate Degree in Electrical / Power Engineering or equivalent. Experience: Experience in large public utilities with generation, transmission and distribution facilities, development of Electricity Tariffs, Commercial Issues and Power Purchase Agreements. Joint Director (Tariff-Finance): Post Graduate in Finance/ Accountancy / Commerce OR CA/ICWA. Experience: Experience in Financial Analysis of Investment decisions in Power Sector. Deputy Director (Tariff Accounts and Financial Analysis): Post Graduate Degree in Accountancy or equivalent OR Qualified Chartered Accountant OR ICWA OR Post Graduate Degree in Finance. Experience: Experience in professional accounting and management of staff, financial analysis of investment decisions. Deputy Director (Tariff Economics): Post Graduate Degree in Economics / MBA (Finance) or equivalent. Experience: Experience in economic analysis, financial procedure in commercial enterprises / Government accounting procedures. Deputy Director (Info-Tech): Graduate degree in Computer Science OR related Field. Experience: Adequate experience of handling computer systems in Govt. Department / PSU OR large private organization including managerial responsibilities. Assistant Director (Info-Tech): Engineering Graduate in Computer Science/Information Technology OR MCA. Experience: Project work in RDBMS OR Web enabled projects, Two years' experience in Operation and Maintenance of LAN in large organization.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DERC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 26-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DERC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Delhi Electricity Regulatory Commission (DERC) for various leadership and technical positions based in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available for posts including Executive Director, Joint Director, Deputy Director, and Assistant Director.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 26 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for DERC Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the online mode by visiting the official website of the Delhi Electricity Regulatory Commission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts under this deputation recruitment is 56 years as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for DERC posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing of candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by a skill test or interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive salaries ranging from Level-10 (Rs. 56,100) to Level-14 (Rs. 2,18,200) as per the 7th CPC pay matrix.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified or mentioned in the official notification released by the Delhi Electricity Regulatory Commission for these posts.

faq.question: Q9. What type of recruitment is this?
faq.answer: This is a deputation-based government recruitment opportunity offered by DERC for qualified professionals in engineering, finance, IT, and economics.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by visiting the Important Links section of this article and clicking on the provided link.
